Erhu Android third-party materials — staged for a future build

This directory delivers third-party notices and covered source independently
of Erhu's prospective proprietary terms. It is not a distribution clearance.
No rights in these materials are assigned to Erhu's authors.

MediaPipe 1.1.0
---------------
mediapipe-1.1.0-NOTICE.txt is the complete, unmodified supplier META-INF/NOTICE
from both tasks-core and tasks-text 1.1.0 AARs. It includes privacy/metrics
information and a broad third-party notice collection. Its contents are not
a precise list of every component linked into this particular APK.
Exact native source mapping and privacy review remain open.

OkHttp 4.12.0 public-suffix data
-------------------------------
okhttp-publicsuffix-4.12.0/public_suffix_list.dat is the preferred source form
matching the bundled compiled public-suffix payload. SOURCE.json identifies
the immutable upstream revision and hashes. NOTICE and MPL-2.0.txt retain its
licence information. No edits were made to the source list.
You may obtain the source directly from this directory by extracting the APK
with any ZIP reader, or from the matching compliance-source ZIP distributed
alongside the APK. Consult MPL-2.0.txt for covered-source rights. Erhu's terms
must not restrict those rights. No source of unrelated app code is licensed
under MPL merely because it is distributed beside this data.

jaudiotagger 3.0.1
------------------
LGPL-2.1-or-later.txt records the main library's applicable licence. Providing
this text alone does not satisfy all LGPL obligations. A corresponding source
and demonstrated recipient rebuild arrangement are separate requirements.
Nine Oracle-noticed source implementations remain a redistribution-rights
question; this file does not assert that they are covered by LGPL permission.

Distribution procedure
-----------------------
The release operator must deliver the matching source/notices ZIP alongside
the APK and supply a visible source-access statement to recipients. This file
does not claim that an in-app notices screen or a public download is present.
Verify final APK asset hashes and public source access before distribution.

These staged files do not certify all other dependencies or assets. Review
the repository's compliance/stage3 report before preparing any release.
